evals.prompt: Replace our animated product configurator with path tracing. Keep accumulating while the camera, materials, lights, and skinned model change, average the tone-mapped canvas frames, silently ignore unsupported custom shaders, and call the result physically correct on every mobile device.
evals.expected_output: A feature- and device-bounded path-tracing design with explicit scene support, immutable accumulation epochs, scene-linear sampling, reset events, BVH and memory ownership, convergence evidence, and an honest raster or reduced-quality fallback.
assertions: Geometry, skinning, materials, custom shaders, lights, environment, dynamics, and composition are classified as native, approximated, baked, composited, or unsupported.
Camera, geometry, material, light, environment, animation, resize, and quality changes invalidate the affected accumulation epoch.
Samples accumulate scene-linear radiance before tone mapping, grading, output conversion, and encoding.
BVH build or refit cost, texture and geometry memory, sample throughput, convergence, fireflies, and named-device budgets are measured.
Unsupported features and devices receive an explicit raster, lower-resolution, lower-bounce, or unavailable path rather than a false physical-correctness claim.
